name: How do I choose the right contractor for my detached ADU project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my detached ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for a successful detached ADU project. Look for licensed and insured general contractors with specific experience in ADU construction. Request references from previous clients and review their portfolios. Ensure they provide a detailed, transparent proposal outlining costs, timelines, and scope of work. Communication style and local knowledge of permitting processes are also important factors to consider for a smooth project experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with ADU experience, check references, review portfolios, and ensure they provide a detailed proposal.
